input: I just noticed that I was charged $49.99 twice for my Pro Plan subscription this billing cycle -- once on the 1st and again on the 3rd. This is the second time this has happened in three months, and I need the duplicate charge refunded immediately. Please let me know when I can expect this to be resolved.

The mobile app keeps crashing whenever I try to upload a photo to my profile. I've tried reinstalling it twice and restarting my phone, but the crash happens every single time. This is blocking me from completing my profile setup.
I forgot my password and would like to reset it whenever it's convenient. No rush.

I've been using the Analytics Dashboard daily and it's honestly made my job so much easier. One small suggestion: it would be great if a dark mode option was added in a future update, since I often use it late at night.

For the past day, some of our checkout requests through your API have intermittently returned 500 errors -- roughly one in every ten attempts. It's frustrating since it's inconsistent and hard to reproduce, but it's not affecting every customer, so this week would be fine for a fix.
My invoice this month is $12 higher than last month's without any change in my plan. Could someone explain the charge before my next payment is due in a few days?
Do you have an office location in Berlin? I'm trying to find a local contact for a potential partnership and wanted to check before reaching out further.

Someone I don't recognize logged into my account this morning and changed the email address on file, so I can no longer log in or receive password reset emails. I need urgent help securing my account and reversing this change.

I've been a customer for almost three years now and honestly this is the first time I've ever had to complain about anything. Your service has generally been great, and I've recommended it to at least four colleagues over the years. But something happened this week that I really need addressed.

I checked my bank statement this morning and saw an $89.00 charge from your company that I don't recognize at all. It's not my usual monthly amount, and I definitely didn't sign up for anything new or upgrade my plan. I need this looked into and reversed if it's a mistake, and I'd like to know soon since it's thrown off my budget for the month.
The export button on the Reports page doesn't seem to do anything when I click it.

Hi, I hope this is the right place to ask this. My coworker and I share a login for our team's reporting tool, and last week she mentioned she can access the admin settings page but I can't, even though we're using the exact same account and password. I'm not sure if there are different permission levels tied to certain logins or if something's off with how my access is set up. Could someone check what's going on with my account permissions?
Any chance you could add CSV export to the Invoices page? Would save me a ton of manual copying every month.

This is the third time this week I'm reaching out about the same issue. Every time I try to sync my calendar, it just spins forever and then eventually times out. I've already tried logging out and back in, clearing the cache, and even reinstalling the app completely -- nothing works.

I have back-to-back client meetings tomorrow and I need my calendar syncing properly tonight. Please escalate this if you have to, I can't keep working around it manually.
Do you offer student discounts, and if so, how would I go about applying for one?

We recently moved our team over to the Enterprise Plan, and I want to say the onboarding call was really helpful. That said, when I was reviewing our first invoice under the new plan, the per-seat price listed didn't match the number our account rep quoted us during the call. I don't think anyone did anything wrong, I just want to make sure we're being billed correctly going forward before the next cycle bills automatically.

I've been locked out of my account for two hours now. Every password reset email I request either never arrives or the link says it's expired within seconds of clicking it. I have a deadline in a few hours and I need access restored right away -- this is genuinely costing me time I don't have.

I'm integrating with your API and running into an issue I wanted to flag. When I send a POST request to the /reports endpoint with more than 100 items in the payload, I get a 413 error back, even though your documentation doesn't mention a payload size limit anywhere.

I've worked around it for now by batching my requests into smaller chunks of 50, so this isn't blocking me at the moment. It would be great if the docs were updated to reflect the actual limit, or if the limit itself could be raised.

Our team currently gets notified about new comments over email, and honestly a lot of us miss them because we don't check that inbox often during the day. I was poking around the settings this morning trying to see if there was a way to redirect those notifications somewhere else, maybe Slack, but I couldn't find anything like that. Is that something that exists already and I'm just not seeing it, or would that need to be built?
Just wanted to say the billing team was super helpful last week when I called in -- is there a way to switch from monthly to annual billing on my own, or do I need to call in again?

I set up two-factor authentication on my account a few months ago using an authenticator app, which has worked fine until this week. I recently got a new phone and transferred everything over, or so I thought, but now when I try to log in, the codes from the app just say 'invalid code' every time, even right after they refresh.

I've tried this on three separate attempts now over the last hour and I'm starting to feel a bit stuck since I can't get into my account at all right now. Is there a way to verify my identity another way so I can get back in and reset 2FA properly?
